implementation_notes: Edges are Cargo dependencies and the compiler is the map. An ACL is a private module inside the downstream crate that is the only place importing the upstream; separate ways is the absence of a dependency. `#![deny(...)]` and a dependency audit script keep it honest.
idiom_name: ACL as a private module; Cargo graph is the enforced map
pitfalls: A shared `contracts` crate both sides depend on until it accumulates both models
